_doc: LTI + Mindtree merger effective 2022-11-14. The combined entity got ticker LTIM (later renamed to LTM in 2026). NSE auto-replaced both LTI and MINDTREE with LTIM in indices that previously held them. Without this override, the walk-back has MINDTREE excluded on 2022-09-30 (per the regular review) but no event re-introducing LTIM until much later.
